_comment: UNVERIFIED starting guesses. Run the copilot_inspect tool (or /inspect in copilot.sh) against your signed-in Copilot page and replace these. Each value is a list of CSS selectors (joined with ', '), except attach_steps, which is a sequence of clicks. Set 'frame' to the iframe's CSS selector if inspect shows the chat inside an iframe. Call copilot_reload_selectors (or /reload) after editing.
_files_comment: file_input: a hidden <input type=file> used directly if present. attach_steps: otherwise, the clicks that open the file picker (e.g. the + button, then 'Upload from this device'). attachment_chip: the element that appears per attached file; when set, prompts are only sent once that many chips show (leave empty to wait COPILOT_UPLOAD_SETTLE_SECONDS instead). upload_busy: shown while uploading. download_button: Download buttons inside replies.
attach_steps: button[aria-label*="Add content"], button[aria-label*="Attach"], button[aria-label*="Upload"], button[aria-label*="Add a file"]
